title: Cryptid Crate Alternatives: 5 Boxes for Monster Fans - Cratejoy
summary: Compare five boxes like Cryptid Crate for monster, UFO, and horror fans, from indie collectibles to signed autographs and books.
body_markdown:
## The alternatives


Closest monthly swap


### LFOD Horror Box vs Cryptid Crate


[LFOD Horror Box](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/lfod-horror-box-livefreeordiepress) by Live Free Or Die Press


From $40.00 / box


Sold out


[See Similar Boxes](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/lfod-horror-box-livefreeordiepress)


**Best for:** The Cryptid Crate subscriber who liked small-press makers and a monthly haul of things to pin, prop up, and stick.


New Hampshire horror author John Durgin builds each box around a small-town New England horror theme, such as “The New Neighbor” or “The Old Road.” Every month brings five items: an enamel pin, a 5x7 art print, a clear bookmark, a die-cut sticker, and a small novelty.


#### What feels familiar


One theme a month from an indie creator, with pins and stickers for a jacket and a print for the wall.


#### What changes


The scares are small-town horror rather than named creatures, and there’s no shirt or book in the box. The listing is new, so it has no subscriber reviews yet.


Signed horror collectibles


### Zobie Fright vs Cryptid Crate


**Best for:** The collector who wants something signed on the shelf and will trade Bigfoot for horror in general.


[Zobie Productions](https://shopzobie.com/products/zobie-fright-monthly-subscription) deals in autographs and collectibles, and its Fright box pairs one authentic celebrity autograph with three horror collectibles each month, drawn from enamel pins, art prints, stickers, shirts, and prop replicas.


#### What feels familiar


You give a shirt size when you subscribe, and some months include a shirt, like most Cryptid Crates. The rest is pins, prints, and props for a display shelf.


#### What changes


The box covers horror in general rather than one creature a month. Shipping is priced by weight and destination, so the total depends on where you live.


The UFO side, as a gift


### Extra-Terrestrial Mystery Box vs Cryptid Crate


[Extra-Terrestrial Mystery Box](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/extra-terrestrial-mystery-box) by The Amazing Mystery Box


$33.76


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/extra-terrestrial-mystery-box)


**Best for:** The friend whose cryptid shelf already has a little gray alien on it.


The Amazing Mystery Box, a UK seller, packs six alien-themed pieces: a backpack, a mug, an “Elliott-inspired” surprise, Predator memorabilia, a Star Trek collectible, and a Doctor Who item.


#### What feels familiar


Cryptid Crate covers UFOs alongside Bigfoot and ghosts, and this box stays on the alien side of that mix. A backpack and a mug are the kind of everyday gear Cryptid Crate tucks in.


#### What changes


Most of the pieces are movie and TV merch rather than indie-made items, and there’s no shirt or book.


For the books


### Night Worms vs Cryptid Crate


**Best for:** The subscriber who read the Systema Paradoxa novella before unfolding the shirt.


[Night Worms](https://nightworms.com/products/night-worms-book-club-package) sends a monthly horror book package with a small themed goodie bag, usually a bookmark, a sticker, and a drink. Its November 2026 package, Creatures in the Dark, holds two books, one hardcover and one paperback.


#### What feels familiar


A new read every month, chosen by two horror fans, with a sticker and a bookmark tucked in beside it.


#### What changes


You lose the shirt and most of the merch. Renewals bill on the 7th, so cancel before then if you want out.


Books and keepsakes, every other month


### Horror Plus Box vs Cryptid Crate


10% off


[Horror Plus Box Book Club- Chilling Books, Exclusive Collectibles & Goodies](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/bi-monthly-horror-plus-box-aboxofstories1) by A Box of Stories Surprise Book Club


From $119.04 / box


Sold out


[See Similar Boxes](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/bi-monthly-horror-plus-box-aboxofstories1)


**Best for:** The reader who wants a heavier box and can wait two months for it.


A Box of Stories, a UK book club, fills the Horror Plus Box with three new horror books, two exclusive keepsakes, a collectible tarot card, and a spooky hot drink, plus personal notes and author Q&As.


#### What feels familiar


Books arrive beside collectibles, which is closer to Cryptid Crate’s mix than a books-only club.


#### What changes


It costs more per box and comes six times a year instead of twelve.
